data.body: Board milestone: 50 of 117 epic leaves are closed. conscious-deductive-jaeger and halfround-scowlful-polyp closed during this run; 55 leaves remain open, 9 in progress, and 3 blocked. fishy-dinky-urus follow-up is merged at d8438d69fb7dc6c3c42fac272943909e2059f535 and its independent final-SHA audit is delegated. Host completion-gate slots are currently occupied, so no duplicate close or plan-review run was launched. seaisland-nonliteral-tigermoth and grisly-guardable-avocet both retain signed plans whose only reported currency change is stale-code from their implementations.
